# Lead Lab data and security
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

The system stores account and learning data in Laravel's database and serves protected resources from local storage. It must not store credentials, private keys, tokens, or real participant data in the repository. `application/source/database/migrations/2026_08_19_120001_create_learning_sessions_table.php:11-20`, `workspace/AGENTS.md:28-39`

## Data model

| Entity | Key data and relationship | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Participant / Administrator / Moderator | A user has a role, activity flag, access status, password, and email-verification timestamp. | `application/source/app/Models/User.php:20-63` |
| Learning Session | Has title, category, date, description, optional video URL, publish flag, archive timestamp, Learning Resources, and Session Questions. | `application/source/app/Models/LearningSession.php:13-35`, `application/source/app/Models/LearningSession.php:83-93` |
| Learning Resource | Belongs to one session and records title, stored path, MIME type, and size. | `application/source/app/Models/LearningResource.php:9-23` |
| Session Question and Session Answer | Both belong to their parent content and author; votes have database uniqueness constraints. | `application/source/database/migrations/2026_08_24_120000_create_session_q_and_a_tables.php:11-42` |
| Calendar Event | Holds times, description, optional location and live broadcast URL, plus three reminder flags. | `application/source/app/Models/CalendarEvent.php:12-54` |
| Reminder delivery | Holds event, recipient, offset, schedule, delivery status, attempts, timestamps, and error. | `application/source/app/Models/CalendarEventReminderDelivery.php:12-56` |
| Activity Log | Records actor, action, polymorphic subject, and metadata. | `application/source/app/Models/ActivityLog.php:9-40` |

## Trust boundaries and controls

| Boundary | Treatment | Enforcement |
|---|---|---|
| Browser requests | Untrusted. Inputs are validated before persistence. | `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:79-96`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminCalendarEventController.php:64-97` |
| Account eligibility | Server-authoritative. The browser cannot grant its own access. | `application/source/app/Http/Middleware/EnsureActiveUser.php:12-29`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminMemberController.php:39-79` |
| Administrator actions | Server-authoritative. Admin routes reject non-administrators. | `application/source/routes/web.php:41-56`, `application/source/app/Http/Middleware/EnsureAdmin.php:11-16` |
| File paths | Stored privately and checked before download. | `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/AdminLearningSessionController.php:237-251`, `application/source/app/Http/Controllers/LearningResourceController.php:12-27` |
| Registration | Rate-limited and validated; new users start pending. | `application/source/app/Actions/Fortify/CreateNewUser.php:25-49` |
| Reminder recipients | Re-evaluated at dispatch and send time; ineligible users are cancelled. | `application/source/app/Services/CalendarEventReminderService.php:49-57`, `application/source/app/Jobs/SendCalendarEventReminder.php:52-62` |

## Limits

Embedded YouTube URLs cannot be guaranteed secret from an authenticated participant. This is an explicit residual-risk decision, not a security guarantee. `workspace/references/security-baseline.md:15-18`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:66-67`

The local email-verification bypass is development-only. Staging and production must reinstate verification and establish mail, queue, scheduler, backup, and monitoring evidence before participant use. `application/environment/local-development.md:47-57`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md:112-123`
